caption: One brewing stand in a 3x6x5 box: a clock (two hoppers passing 106 stones back and forth, a copper bulb remembering the direction) splits time into two halves of 42 seconds. When the brewing half starts, the clock's own torch flashes under the block next to the bulb, which fires two droppers beside it: one lifts a nether wart into the hoppers over the stand, the other a sugar that takes two more hoppers and so arrives later, then waits until the wart is used up: the stand brews awkward potions, then swiftness. The bottles hopper beside the stand is unlocked only in that half and the hopper under the stand only in the other, when it takes the three potions to the output chest (a repeater keeps the bottles hopper locked a moment longer when the halves change, so a fresh bottle is never taken out unbrewed). Blaze powder goes into the stand's side from the fuel chest.
